speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is up. A raw frame, and nobody near it. A hundred yards from the bed, if the bed is where I left it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I am at my window. I am not in the lane. Let me look.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The shutters along the street are shut. I can see that from here. I am not going down.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I am at this window with the house. I am not in the street. I was not in the crowd, and I am not going to be.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor was I. The play was a play nobody listened to, and the crowd was a report, and this is a frame.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: That is not how you ask for bread.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No. It is not.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I have looked a long minute. I have the sentence. I am shutting the shutter.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shut it, mistress. I do not want the lane in the room.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I am barring it. The shutter. Not the street door. The street door is a different bar, and this is not that night.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The window, then. I understand a window. I will not teach anyone a door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sir John is not in the lane. If he is in the house, he is not speaking, and I am not speaking to him.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He may sit. I am not his messenger, and you are not his crowd. Come off the lane.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The chalk on the post is a smear. I cannot read it. I do not want it read to me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then nobody reads it. Empty, and the shutters closed, and her sentence. That is the lane.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I go in behind the mistress. Not into the street. Not to look a second time.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: One look was the long minute. The bar is on the shutter. Come home the ordinary way, and do not bring the frame into the hall on your shoes.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am coming. A hundred yards. I can count that without counting a crowd.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will have the door of the house as a house door. I am not standing in a story.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Mark me. Bread is asked for at a board. This was not a board. I have said the sentence, and I am done saying it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Done is done. I am off the sill.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: And I. The close is enough street for me tonight.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Come in, both of you. The bar stays where I put it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The bar is on the shutter. I can see where it is, and I am not moving it.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Leave it. A window barred is not a street decided.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have said it. I heard you. I am off the lane.
